name: Jianxin

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T4 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Aero Gauntlets ultimate multi-purpose unit: shields, self-healing, grouping (best-in-class Ultimate pull, rivaled only by The Shorekeeper), a free-parry Resonance Skill, and a Liberation-DMG buffing Outro. Master of none individually but fits DPS/Hybrid/Support roles.

skills.normalAttack: Fengyiquan Basic Attack (4 hits) / Heavy Attack / Dodge Counter, all Aero.
skills.resonanceSkill: Calming Air - hold to enter Parry Stance; parries into Chi Counter (no damage taken) or release for Chi Parry.
skills.forte: Primordial Chi Spiral - hold Heavy Attack at max Chi to enter Zhoutian Progress (50% DMG reduction, anti-interrupt, channeled AoE Chi Strikes + escalating shields).
skills.liberation: Purification Force Field - wind field that pulls + AoE Aero DMG twice (cast + on dissipation); best-in-class grouping tool.
skills.intro: Essence of Tao - pull + Aero DMG.
skills.outro: Transcendence - 38% Resonance Liberation DMG Deepen to next character for 14s or until swap.

bestWeapons: Legend of Drunken Hero (79.2%, best gacha-free)
Originite: Type IV (support-build - enables Rejuvenating Glow via self-heal Basic Attacks)
echoSet: Moonlit Clouds (best - 10% Energy Regen + 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro, with Impermanence Heron main echo swap-cancelled before Outro)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Iuno is Jianxin's best DPS to buff (38% Liberation DMG Deepen on her Liberation-heavy damage); also enables a strong Mono Aero team with Aero Rover.

teams.name: F2P Jinhsi Team
teams.notes: Mortefi's post-Ultimate Coordinated Attacks combo with Jianxin's Forte to rapidly refill Jinhsi's Incandescence stacks.

teams.name: Xiangli Yao Team
teams.notes: Budget alternative to Yinlin as Xiangli Yao's Liberation DMG buffer, at the cost of more field time and Energy Regen needs.

rotation: Flexible - keep Resonance Skill on cooldown as a free parry, Basic Attack periodically to keep Rejuvenating Glow/Originite Type IV active, use Echo off cooldown, Ultimate for grouping/Concerto Energy, align Outro with the main DPS's Liberation-DMG burst, and use Forte Circuit situationally (usually a net damage loss but valuable for its shield/Concerto generation).
communityNotes: Prydwen: one of the most diverse kits in the game and arguably the best overworld/comfort Hybrid, but a jack-of-all-trades-master-of-none with limited endgame meta value outside low-investment grouping support in mid Tower of Adversity floors; her 6s-channeled Forte shield is easily interrupted or wasted if the boss moves out of range.
